My son, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments;
My son, keep my teaching in your memory, and my rules in your heart:
我兒，不要忘記我的法則（或譯：指教）；你心要謹守我的誡命；
for they will add length to your days, years and peace to your life.
For they will give you increase of days, years of life, and peace.
因為它必將長久的日子，生命的年數與平安，加給你。
Never let loving devotion or faithfulness leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.
Let not mercy and good faith go from you; let them be hanging round your neck, recorded on your heart;
不可使慈愛、誠實離開你，要繫在你頸項上，刻在你心版上。
Then you will find favor and high regard in the sight of God and man.
So you will have grace and a good name in the eyes of God and men.
這樣，你必在神和世人眼前蒙恩寵，有聰明。
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;
Put all your hope in God, not looking to your reason for support.
你要專心仰賴耶和華，不可倚靠自己的聰明，
in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
In all your ways give ear to him, and he will make straight your footsteps.
在你一切所行的事上都要認定他，他必指引你的路。
Be not wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and turn away from evil.
Put no high value on your wisdom: let the fear of the Lord be before you, and keep yourself from evil:
不要自以為有智慧；要敬畏耶和華，遠離惡事。
This will bring healing to your body and refreshment to your bones.
This will give strength to your flesh, and new life to your bones.
這便醫治你的肚臍，滋潤你的百骨。
Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your harvest;
Give honour to the Lord with your wealth, and with the first-fruits of all your increase:
你要以財物和一切初熟的土產尊榮耶和華。
then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
So your store-houses will be full of grain, and your vessels overflowing with new wine.
這樣，你的倉房必充滿有餘；你的酒醡有新酒盈溢。
My son, do not reject the discipline of the LORD, and do not loathe His rebuke;
My son, do not make your heart hard against the Lord's teaching; do not be made angry by his training:
我兒，你不可輕看耶和華的管教（或譯：懲治），也不可厭煩他的責備；
for the LORD disciplines the one He loves, as does a father the son in whom he delights.
For to those who are dear to him the Lord says sharp words, and makes the son in whom he has delight undergo pain.
因為耶和華所愛的，他必責備，正如父親責備所喜愛的兒子。
Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, the man who acquires understanding,
Happy is the man who makes discovery of wisdom, and he who gets knowledge.
得智慧，得聰明的，這人便為有福。
for she is more profitable than silver, and her gain is better than fine gold.
For trading in it is better than trading in silver, and its profit greater than bright gold.
因為得智慧勝過得銀子，其利益強如精金，
She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire compares with her.
She is of more value than jewels, and nothing for which you may have a desire is fair in comparison with her.
比珍珠（或譯：紅寶石）寶貴；你一切所喜愛的，都不足與比較。
Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
Long life is in her right hand, and in her left are wealth and honour.
她右手有長壽，左手有富貴。
All her ways are pleasant, and all her paths are peaceful.
Her ways are ways of delight, and all her goings are peace.
她的道是安樂；她的路全是平安。
She is a tree of life to those who embrace her, and those who lay hold of her are blessed.
She is a tree of life to all who take her in their hands, and happy is everyone who keeps her.
她與持守她的作生命樹；持定她的，俱各有福。
The LORD founded the earth by wisdom and established the heavens by understanding.
The Lord by wisdom put in position the bases of the earth; by reason he put the heavens in their place.
耶和華以智慧立地，以聰明定天，
By His knowledge the watery depths were broken open, and the clouds dripped with dew.
By his knowledge the deep was parted, and dew came dropping from the skies.
以知識使深淵裂開，使天空滴下甘露。
My son, do not lose sight of this: Preserve sound judgment and discernment.
My son, keep good sense, and do not let wise purpose go from your eyes.
我兒，要謹守真智慧和謀略，不可使她離開你的眼目。
They will be life to your soul and adornment to your neck.
So they will be life for your soul, and grace for your neck.
這樣，她必作你的生命，頸項的美飾。
Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.
Then you will go safely on your way, and your feet will have no cause for slipping.
你就坦然行路，不致碰腳。
When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you rest, your sleep will be sweet.
When you take your rest you will have no fear, and on your bed sleep will be sweet to you.
你躺下，必不懼怕；你躺臥，睡得香甜。
Do not fear sudden danger or the ruin that overtakes the wicked,
Have no fear of sudden danger, or of the storm which will come on evil-doers:
忽然來的驚恐，不要害怕；惡人遭毀滅，也不要恐懼。
for the LORD will be your confidence and will keep your foot from the snare.
For the Lord will be your hope, and will keep your foot from being taken in the net.
因為耶和華是你所倚靠的；他必保守你的腳不陷入網羅。
Do not withhold good from the deserving when it is within your power to act.
Do not keep back good from those who have a right to it, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
你手若有行善的力量，不可推辭，就當向那應得的人施行。
Do not tell your neighbor, “Come back tomorrow and I will provide”— when you already have the means.
Say not to your neighbour, Go, and come again, and tomorrow I will give; when you have it by you at the time.
你那裡若有現成的，不可對鄰舍說：去吧，明天再來，我必給你。
Do not devise evil against your neighbor, for he trustfully dwells beside you.
Do not make evil designs against your neighbour, when he is living with you without fear.
你的鄰舍既在你附近安居，你不可設計害他。
Do not accuse a man without cause, when he has done you no harm.
Do not take up a cause at law against a man for nothing, if he has done you no wrong.
人未曾加害與你，不可無故與他相爭。
Do not envy a violent man or choose any of his ways;
Have no envy of the violent man, or take any of his ways as an example.
不可嫉妒強暴的人，也不可選擇他所行的路。
for the LORD detests the perverse, but He is a friend to the upright.
For the wrong-hearted man is hated by the Lord, but he is a friend to the upright.
因為，乖僻人為耶和華所憎惡；正直人為他所親密。
The curse of the LORD is on the house of the wicked, but He blesses the home of the righteous.
The curse of the Lord is on the house of the evil-doer, but his blessing is on the tent of the upright.
耶和華咒詛惡人的家庭，賜福與義人的居所。
He mocks the mockers, but gives grace to the humble.
He makes sport of the men of pride, but he gives grace to the gentle-hearted.
他譏誚那好譏誚的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。
The wise will inherit honor, but fools are held up to shame.
The wise will have glory for their heritage, but shame will be the reward of the foolish.
智慧人必承受尊榮；愚昧人高升也成為羞辱。
